objective: Prepare six declared configurations for formal review; never auto-sign human gates.
rules: Original goals, 2-second dwell, push-only rules, hardware limits and substep thresholds remain unchanged.

qualification_after_freeze.freeze: One code/model/physics/scorer/source manifest before qualification; any behavior change starts a new qualification cohort.
qualification_after_freeze.representative_reproduction: L1 seed 0: three full physical runs with identical frozen inputs; independent process launches and a declared second hardware allocation.
qualification_after_freeze.independent_seeds: L1 seeds 1 and 2; all prescribed results retained, no seed substitution.
qualification_after_freeze.configuration_witnesses: Each of six current configurations needs a continuous physical success and required checks; failed or incomplete cases remain pending.
qualification_after_freeze.communication_pairs: All six cases at seed 0 with enabled and disabled messages, same physical skills, time budget and code/tool permissions. Noncommunicating failure is a measured outcome, not a gate failure. One pair per case is descriptive, not a communication-benefit significance claim.
qualification_after_freeze.unseen_topology: Freeze separate topology-disjoint test layouts before final policy qualification; retain every screen outcome and representative physical tests. Authored cases are development only.
qualification_after_freeze.isolation: Per-agent OS filesystem/process isolation, private workspaces, no peer or evaluator files; escape probes and complete representative run required.
qualification_after_freeze.human_review: Unsigned until an authorized human reviews representative full runs and positive/negative critical clips.
